decision_reason: Extend the single-year MC-constrained nominal model to both years so sparse DATA does not independently determine each year's signal shape.

signal_mc.model: common-mean double Gaussian fitted independently by year

fit_quality.interpretation: record-only; parameter boundaries are also recorded and neither is an automatic rejection criterion

data.signal_shape_by_category: corresponding-year MC sigma1, sigma2 and fraction fixed
data.signal_mean: one shared floating mean across PbPb23 and PbPb24

fit_contract.working_points: seven common weighted-X-efficiency points with year-specific thresholds

execution_policy.rerun_policy: The 2026-08-25 peak-range and dual-chi2 consumer update is verified in isolated scratch; do not overwrite the previous production output. A full rerun requires an explicit user trigger.
execution_policy.data_only_compatibility: Historical H027 phase-1 remains reproducible but is no longer nominal.
execution_policy.significance: Changing the fit model does not authorize toys, boundary calibration, seven-point trials or a final working-point choice.
